description: Quiet wrapper minimization of the ultra-min BCJ package. This variant keeps v5's removed subprocess check path but suppresses bundled binary stderr to preserve clean scorer output.

build.packaging: Ultra-min Python wrapper with one-character payload files and suppressed bundled binary output.

basis: Same BCJ-filtered executable payload and same cmix-compressed dictionary as v4/v5; only wrapper source changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

1k_current_driver.output_behavior: Bundled cmix stdout and stderr are suppressed.

64k_inherited_from_bcj_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary and dictionary payload are byte-identical to the current-driver verified BCJ parent package.

1m_inherited_from_bcj_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary and dictionary payload are byte-identical to the current-driver verified BCJ parent package.

verdict: Promote as the clean-output package leader for the old sidecar byte-split line. It gives back 18 bytes versus v5 to keep bundled binary stderr suppressed, and still beats v4 by 16 bytes.
